title: Tottenham Lose to Aston Villa and Remain in the Relegation Zone
seoTitle: Tottenham Lose to Aston Villa, Stay in Relegation Zone
subtitle: Villa take the lead through Johan Manzambi as Spurs remain winless after conceding first
excerpt: In a Premier League match, Tottenham lost 1-0 to Aston Villa. Manzambi's goal at the break leaves the club in the relegation zone and winless.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the afternoon of September 19, Tottenham faced Aston Villa at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and suffered a 1-0 defeat. Johan Manzambi's goal, scored at 45+4 minutes, mounted further pressure on the club, who remain in the relegation zone and winless when trailing.

What happened in the first half

Tottenham started with good intensity, controlling the tempo and creating opportunities, though without clear-cut chances. The first half ended 0-1 after Manzambi pounced on a rebound inside the box to score the only goal of the match.

Tottenham's record when trailing

The club have failed to win any of their last 58 matches across all competitions when falling behind, according to Premier League records. In the Premier League specifically, the team has not won in 36 fixtures after conceding first, continuing their trend of negative results.

Impact of the defeat on the table

With the defeat, Tottenham remain in the relegation zone heading into the international break. The run of unfavorable results leaves the club in a precarious position for the second half of the season.

Key moments and missed chances

Besides Manzambi's goal, Tottenham had several chances, including a strike by Nicolas Jackson that was saved by Antonín Kinsky. The Villa goalkeeper produced two crucial saves to protect the lead. The team also received a yellow card for a foul on Jackson, but failed to convert their opportunities into goals.

Upcoming challenges for Tottenham

Following the international break, Tottenham return to action against Manchester United. Improving attacking efficiency and reversing their winless record when falling behind will be vital to escaping the relegation zone.

With information from BBC, The Guardian, Goal.com.
